data.key: Order of the Green ~ End of the Cycle
data.name: End of the Cycle
data.description: Anything killed by an order of the green cavalier tends to stay dead. When the cavalier kills  a creature, it is treated as if it were killed by a death effect for purposes of magic that can restore it to life. In addition, it's placed under the effects of a permanent sanctify corpse effect (using the cavalier's level as the spell's caster level).
